description: Capability scoped to the local-only Steam bridge invite picker window (quick 261101-llf). It grants exactly the plugin commands the app bundle calls at boot -- the notification init-script probe (plugin:notification|is_permission_granted) and event listen/unlisten for tauriTransport -- plus core:window:allow-close for the picker's own Close. There is deliberately no remote key and no webviews key, and the window's on_navigation hook pins it to the app origin. This is NOT a capability for the about or external-<n> child windows: default.json's REQ-34.1-08 rule that those labels get zero command access still stands.
